source.title: [EPIC] Build JD Services & Solutions into a service-business operating platform
source.body:
> **EXECUTION PRIORITY UPDATE — 2026-11-21 (owner direction).** Focus the next two PRs on a visible Admin milestone, not building the whole file-backed CRM at once: **#30 (PR 1: branded login screen + responsive empty owner dashboard shell)** followed by **#31 (PR 2: secure real owner login, session and logout backed by a minimal private TS service)**. Do not wait for #17/#18 complete collection engine to build the UI; integrate those incrementally once login is proven. Existing #5 CRM, #6 inventory, #7 repairs, #8 finance, #10 CMS, #15 feedback and #20 schema-driven forms remain OPEN, **one functional Admin tab per later PR**, with real data only when private storage is deployed. #19 is an umbrella API roadmap, not authorization to implement every endpoint in the auth PR. **Urgent live production rendering defect #28 remains the top release/incident blocker**; fix it before claiming the public website verified or shipping other public UI changes. No passwords in Git, no client-side-only auth, no real private customer data or unapproved paid service. Keep the public Render static site separately deployable.

## Objective
Evolve the current static JD Services & Solutions website into a trustworthy, conversion-focused public experience and, in controlled phases, an owner-operated system for enquiries, customers, service jobs, technicians, spare-parts inventory, quotations, payments and marketing performance.

## Business context
JD Services & Solutions, Erode. Multi-brand repair and field-service operations:
- Mobile and laptop repairs (pickup/drop-off may be coordinated for small devices).
- LED TV, washing machine and other home-appliance service (onsite visits where appropriate).
- Spare-parts sourcing, stock tracking and parts used against repair jobs.
- Coordinate in-house/partner technicians across locations and workloads.
- Contact: 8940454360 (Call & WhatsApp).
- Tagline: “Service Today... Smile Tomorrow...”

## Current verified baseline
- Public website is a single root `index.html` with inline CSS and static content.
- No backend, database, admin UI, CRM, persistent enquiry capture, stock module or campaign attribution is currently present in this repository.
- Existing GitHub issue tracker was empty before this roadmap.
- Preserve the working Render static site while building the next phases; do not pretend WhatsApp clicks are saved CRM leads.
- Official brand logo must be used only when the real asset is supplied/available; never approximate it.

## Delivery principles
- Issue-first: each focused change gets its own issue, branch, PR, CI and verification.
- Never commit directly to `main`; merge only after checks and explicit owner approval.
- Keep the public website deployable independently from any future API/admin service.
- No paid services, paid Render resources, external messaging, customer emails or live customer data without explicit owner approval.
- Protect customer contact details, device identifiers, credentials and service records.
- Do not claim stock availability unless inventory quantities are actually recorded and current.

## Roadmap — implementation issues
P0:
- #3 Premium public website redesign and service enquiry conversion UX.
- #4 Secure backend, database and deployment architecture decision.
- #5 Owner-only admin dashboard and CRM lead/service pipeline.

P1:
- #6 Spare-parts inventory, stock ledger, supplier sourcing and reorder alerts.
- #7 Service job lifecycle, technician assignment, pickup/onsite scheduling and activity timeline.
- #8 Estimates, invoices, payment tracking and job profitability.
- #9 Campaign landing pages, UTM attribution and measurable marketing funnel.
- #10 Editable service/FAQ/offer CMS and media controls.
- #11 Deterministic AGENTS.md/project-context sync and CI drift guard.

## Dependencies and delivery order
Start with #3 (public UI). In parallel, review #4 architecture without provisioning paid resources. CRM (#5) follows the approved backend decision; inventory (#6) and service operations (#7) share customer/job/part contracts; estimates (#8) consume job and stock-cost data. Campaign attribution (#9) should connect to real CRM records. CMS (#10) builds on owner auth. Workflow automation (#11) can be developed alongside the other phases.

## Exit criteria
The epic stays open until the public enquiry → CRM lead → service job → technician/parts → estimate/payment → after-service follow-up journey works end-to-end with secure persistence, owner approval, documented operational limits and verified deployment.

---

## Flat-file implementation expansion — 2026-11-21 (NEBO-inspired, JD-specific)

**Owner-selected architecture:** pure JSON/JSONL records, JSON Schema contracts, YAML collection/config registry, Markdown content and Mermaid diagrams. Continue to use the public Git repository only for approved non-secret catalogue and publishing inputs. Store all private CRM, device, stock, job, invoice, payment, media and feedback information in a **private, durable, authenticated flat-file runtime service** separate from the Render static site. No SQLite/SQL implementation in the planned first version; reconsider only as an explicit future scaling/reliability decision. See the updated owner clarification in #4.

### P0 — unblock private collections safely
- [ ] #17 NEBO-style `collections.yml` registry + versioned JSON Schemas / TypeScript contracts
- [ ] #18 Single-writer atomic, revision-checked JSON/JSONL records + journal/recovery engine
- [ ] #19 Owner-authenticated TypeScript API; secure public enquiries/feedback routes
- [ ] #25 Backup/restore, private storage durability, retention, recoverability and hosting safeguards
- [ ] Existing #4 architecture and deployment decision remains a mandatory gate

### P1 — connect schema to JD-specific business usage
- [ ] Existing #5 CRM leads/customers/devices and follow-ups
- [ ] Existing #6 spare-parts and repair inventory movements
- [ ] Existing #7 job cards, technician dispatch, pickup/onsite scheduling
- [ ] Existing #8 repair estimates, invoices/payments, job profitability
- [ ] #20 Registry-driven responsive owner Admin CMS forms, lists and resource permission policies
- [ ] #21 Accessories retail inquiries/sales linked to shared stock but separate from repair parts usage
- [ ] #22 Generate public service, accessory, FAQ and campaign pages from JSON/YAML/Markdown
- [ ] #23 Consent-aware customer messaging and durable file-backed outbox
- [ ] #24 Private job intake photos, receipts and attachment storage
- [ ] #26 Generate Mermaid ERDs/business workflow maps from live schema and validate drift
- [ ] Existing #9 campaign attribution, #10 owner content CMS, #11 AGENTS/index sync, #15 feedback inbox and #16 browser/release workflow remain authoritative

### P2 — optional and reversible
- [ ] #27 Audited read-only-first Admin AI helper and owner-confirmed drafts/actions

### Business completion test
One synthetic enquiry -> customer/device -> repair job/pickup or onsite visit -> technician and reserved stock -> estimate approval -> part consumption -> invoice / partial payment -> customer communication -> feedback. In parallel a distinct **accessory sale** consumes shared stock while retaining separate customer sale/receipt records. The entire journey must survive a process restart and pass restore, concurrency, idempotency, privacy and permission tests. Existing WhatsApp/call CTAs stay operational until a real private write API is deployed.

### Research and verification
Reference: `getwinharris/nebowellness_php_cms` `SchemaService.php`, `ResourceService.php`, `MailQueueService.php`, `storage/schema/collections.php`, docs/architecture and admin pages. Reuse concepts, not PHP/MySQL code or clinic-specific records. Source repository examined; the live Render site could not be independently opened through the available browser/web session, so production UI behavior is **not** claimed verified.

Do **not** close this epic merely because schemas/empty admin screens exist. No paid hosting/services, real customer-data ingestion, messages or unapproved prices/warranties without explicit owner approval.
